scope: Untimed original Omarchy qualification with recorded COW-only root serial getty; all v5 asset, workload, browser, retention and budget pins are inherited unchanged

desktopBootstrap.reason: The pinned sanitized image has neither sudo nor visudo and autologins omarchy on ttyS0. The frozen T01 workload writes /root and stages a tool under /usr/local/bin. A recorded COW-only serial-getty override supplies the required root shell without changing the immutable base image or production site.
desktopBootstrap.bootargs: root=/dev/vda rw console=ttyS0 earlycon=sbi plymouth.enable=0 init=/bin/bash -- -i
desktopBootstrap.rescuePrompt: PID-1 Bash root prompt before systemd
desktopBootstrap.handoff: Write and hash-verify only the guest COW serial-getty override, sync it, then exec the original /sbin/init as PID 1; require the new ttyS0 root prompt to report uid 0, HOME=/root and the exact override hash.
desktopBootstrap.evidence: The initial witness precedes the bootstrap. Classify every bootstrap UART offer and disk completion in the saved journal, preserve immutable image/manifest hashes, and compare the complete end state during replay. This is a local qualification session, not a production image change.
